questions.q: Painful menstruation with no pelvic pathology, starting soon after menarche, is called:
questions.why: Secondary dysmenorrhoea has a cause such as endometriosis.

questions.q: The commonest cause of community-acquired pneumonia is:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. The pneumococcus.

questions.q: Sudden high fever with burning, radiating heat felt by the hand, a bright red face, dilated pupils and throbbing carotids calls for:
questions.why: Belladonna: suddenness, intense dry heat, redness, throbbing and dilated pupils; Aconite lacks the throbbing congestion and has fear and restlessness.

questions.q: Microcytic hypochromic anaemia is most often due to:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. Commonest anaemia in India.

questions.q: Pain in the upper abdomen going through to the back, with very high serum amylase, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Gallstones and alcohol are the main causes.

questions.q: 'Synthesis' is a modern repertory edited by:
questions.why: Repertorium Homoeopathicum Syntheticum, used in RADAR software.

questions.q: The process of choosing the most similar remedy using a repertory is called:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. It narrows the remedies to a few for study in the materia medica.

questions.q: The pentavalent vaccine in India's UIP protects against diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus and:
opts: hepatitis B and Haemophilus influenzae type b
questions.why: Pentavalent = DPT + Hep B + Hib, given at 6, 10 and 14 weeks.

questions.q: The abbreviation 'a.c.' on a prescription means:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Ante cibum; p.c. = after meals.

questions.q: The sugar of milk used in homoeopathy is chemically:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. A disaccharide of glucose and galactose.
